title: Evidence to Decision: one honest contract for Scion quality

claims.summary: Scion is Course Mapper's constrained authoring system rather than a newly trained foundation model. Scion Draft requests Pollinations' legacy openai-fast alias, but the anonymous provider selects and may change the actual backing model; Course Mapper owns the stable contract, compiler, grader, and export path.

One explainable evidence-to-decision scenario contract now drives standard and public prompting, admission, projection, and evaluation, with independent checks and named issue codes for context, decision, evidence packet, tension, and concrete materials.

Missing or rejected scenarios may recover only from admitted facts, examples, and misconception/correction atoms, with derived-kernel-fallback provenance. Deterministic rationale projection preserves authored contrasts and otherwise names an authored competing option without adding a new subject claim.

The paired quiz diagnostic counts all course sessions in scenario denominators, reports derived fallbacks and failing issue codes, evaluates explicit candidate release bars, and exits nonzero in strict mode while preserving the one-pair directional-evidence claim boundary.

Public Scion retries incomplete envelopes slowly, rotates admission recovery across missing lessons, and reserves four free-route recovery calls while paid routes keep two. The final local real-browser run reached 99/A with zero findings, 12/12 enrichment, every strict quiz bar passed, and reported cost $0.

Quiz DOCX export no longer appends an empty spacer after the final quiz, preventing a long answer key from producing a blank trailing page. Representative Lessons 1, 8, and 12 were rendered; the corrected Lesson 12 file ends cleanly on page four.
